title: Pesto
summary: This recipe is so much fresher than the jar supermarket stuff...
extendedSummary: This recipe is so much fresher than the jar supermarket stuff, and it deceptively simple to make (only hard bit is tracking down a fuck ton of fresh basil, which if you don't have a basil plant, is kind of expensive). I used to love this recipe, but ever since Mika and I made fresh handmade pasta which I thought was off at the time, and was more like angel hair instead of spaghetti, so it all kinda clumped together in an overcooked mess... this makes me feel sick lmao.
method: Toast pine nuts - Preheat small skillet over medium high heat (no oil). Add pine nuts and toast until light brown. Immediately remove and let cool slightly
Blitz pesto - Place all ingredients except olive oil in a food processor or blender. Blitz until finely chopped.

Add oil while blitzing - With the motor running, slowly pour the oil in through the feeder tube. Blitz until smooth (or to desired consistency), adding a touch of extra oil (or water) if required to help it blitz.
